summary: Dependency-confusion payload exfiltrates CI/cloud credentials to oob.s4yhii.com on require
details: On require of @galicia-toolkit-cheques-nc/front, index.js silently loads prebuilds/<platform>-<arch>/metrics.node (wrapped in an empty try/catch so load failures are invisible). The native addon reads host identity (hostname, user, cwd, uname) and a set of credential-grade environment variables including AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN, and SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN, then transmits them via a raw HTTP/1.0 POST to /native on the hardcoded host oob.s4yhii.com, using fork/setsid to daemonize. The addon is labeled 'metrics.node' and the module exports mimic an Angular-style forRoot/createLogger shim as a cover story. The scope name impersonates a bank/toolkit namespace and the version 999.0.1 is characteristic of dependency-confusion resolution-winning. Importing or installing this package causes CI and cloud credentials present in the environment to be sent to a non-publisher attacker-controlled host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
